modules.name: Design System
modules.description: Shared warm-paper color tokens, WCAG AA/AAA contrast pairs, typography scales, and platform theming across iOS (Apple HIG) and Web (Material Design 3).

modules.name: Notes & Reader
modules.description: Note list, native search, sidebar drawer with 84-day heatmap overview and graphical date filter, quick composer with tag suggestions, and full-screen serif reader/editor.

modules.name: Random Walk
modules.description: Semantic gravity constellation graph with focus card, cross-book/same-book/memo related hops, previous-hop stack, and reader/AI handoff.

modules.name: AI Chat
modules.description: Grounded note Q&A, streaming reasoning step cards, clickable citations, pinned note context, history drawer, model/effort picker, and AI settings.

modules.name: Insights & Profile
modules.description: Recipe board of analytical lenses, scope preview and run sheet, markdown report viewer with citations, custom lens editor, and personal profile workspace.

modules.name: Auth, Settings & Import
modules.description: OAuth and token sign-in, 5 accent themes, self-hosted server configuration, semantic index status, Obsidian sync, and WeRead/Joplin import dialogs.
